title: Independently review the synthetic attempt-retention contract from #659
body:
## Goal
Report, do not fix. Independently review only the three-file synthetic attempt-evidence package from #659 against its pinned sources. Expected gain: a pinned CLEAR/NOT-CLEAR verdict and reproducible findings in .session/report.md, with a detailed review ledger in .session/artifacts/attempt-evidence-review-0144.json. Determine whether lossless byte retention, identity/linkage and failure accounting support this bounded preparation contract without inventing real authority or admission. This is not whole-method readiness, product work or a repeat of the closed grouping review. No session can run LabVIEW.
## Acceptance
- [ ] First inspect .session/exports/manifest.json and staged input availability/identity only. Before reading the author's package, controls, report or observation ledgers, derive independent retention/linkage/accounting expectations from the normative sources listed below and save them in .session/artifacts/attempt-evidence-expectations-0144.json. Record prior exposure and model fallback honestly; claim independent derivation only to the extent supported, never model-unseen or historical blindness.
- [ ] Then read the package and exported #659 report. Pin starting commit/tree, the exact three file hashes and all relevant source pins; confirm the report's package checkpoint a27fa31f16e4760ce80448ef4ac1e71ff3eb8846 against available bytes, distinguishing current checkout from historical provenance. Check staged compatibility/results artifact hashes against the report. Missing inputs are availability limits, not evidence of absence: continue repository technical review, explicitly narrow historical conclusions and do not reconstruct missing originals.
- [ ] Inspect executable dependencies before running the bounded repository checker or selected helpers. Run independent probes after saving their expected outcomes, not only the author's saved controls. Check exact recovery of request/response/error bytes including NUL/invalid UTF-8 and malformed/truncated JSON; absent versus present zero-byte response; null versus attached legacy record; payload encoding/hash/size/reference corruption; evidence identity/producer/version/UTC/verification; duplicate/mismatched slot/group/repetition/attempt order; every retained failed/interrupted attempt and missing/unplanned arms. Derive counts from bytes. Preserve each failed probe and harness correction; distinguish harness errors from product findings.
- [ ] Check inventories and synthetic completion independently: parsing and legacy validity stay separate from transport outcome, repetitions from attempt order, multiple attempts remain unresolved, failed/missing/unbound arms cannot complete comparisons, and retry/selection/stopping policy is not silently authorized. Check separate correctness/grounding denominators against pinned source definitions without inventing semantic scores. Probe plausible bypasses outside the author's controls, including wrong-response reuse and fabricated authority/admission. Local consistency must not become provider/storage/isolation trust.
- [ ] Verify legacy schema/null reasons, relevant source hashes and grouping boundary remain unchanged; invoking the retained grouping checker is a compatibility check, not a reopened review. Actual admissions, model/reader/native executions, scored runs, semantic passes and real comparisons remain zero; costs unavailable and benchmark_ready=false. Distinguish unconditional admission blocking from a verified real-admission algorithm. Do not run historical builders, main/check, evaluator, transport or native code.
- [ ] Report CLEAR or NOT-CLEAR for this exact bounded package, with finding IDs, severity, source pointers, minimal reproductions, expected/observed outcomes and precise next correction scope. Preserve historical expectation chronology/exposure limitations separately from technical correctness. Write only .session/report.md and .session/artifacts/; no repository review file, edits, index promotion, owner request, thresholds, readiness declaration or repair. No repeated probes to compensate for a missing historical artifact.
## Verification
python3 -c "import hashlib,pathlib; pins={'benchmark/attempt-evidence-0143.md':'a61bc54a41d9a66d65f202a8ad711f1d75848922e7da4ecf0fc86485353074eb','benchmark/attempt-evidence-0143.json':'a8c4d2a1ee0e9bed311c5f002bd4a107ab4784fc9791f35625649ec25fad1a78','benchmark/verify_attempt_evidence_0143.py':'582b5c27275d62c5fdaa1e948cc3bb7f08dfd2be8b282b86fbd2cd677480a799'}; assert all(hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for p,h in pins.items()); print('reviewed repository scope unchanged')"
This engine check verifies repository identity only; the report and artifact carry the review verdict and probe evidence. The engine cannot read session artifacts.
## Context
Iteration 0143 accepted and merged #659 (task commit cbe4e00). The shaper read its report and benchmark/attempt-evidence-0143.md: the old validator rejects empty/truncated responses; a separate synthetic envelope retains originals and inventories independently of parsing. The author's reported saved-control success is not an independent measurement. Existing technical grouping F1 clearance stays closed. The unsuccessful bounded POC was delivered; benchmark preparation resumed. Whole-method review and owner acceptance remain prerequisites to product implementation.
## Budget
First phase: docs/perpetua/evaluation.md and docs/perpetua/roles.md; benchmark/project-run-binding-0138.md; only /future_extension, /binding_design, /pins and relevant plan/rehearsal pointers of benchmark/project-run-binding-0138.json; benchmark/baseline/run-record.template.json and run-manifest.template.json; attempt/failure/repetition/evidence portions of benchmark/baseline/runner-contract.md and benchmark/project-paired-0136.md; selected validate/score_answer/bind_manifest definitions in benchmark/scripts/run_record.py and required helper definitions in benchmark/verify_project_run_binding_0138.py. Save initial expectations before later reads. Later phase: the three benchmark/attempt-evidence-0143 files (checker is benchmark/verify_attempt_evidence_0143.py), exported report #659, .session/inputs/659-attempt-compatibility-0143.json and .session/inputs/659-attempt-evidence-results-0143.json. Select JSON pointers; no whole large JSON/base64/binary dumps. At most two additional directly linked references for a demonstrated ambiguity; no broad history search, original key/C1 review, grouping review replay, evaluator or old builders. Keep command output short, save detailed probes in artifacts and report the first substantive finding early.
